text.en: This Order may be cited as the Property, Rights and Liabilities (Appointed Day) Order.
The appointed day for the purposes of section 8(1) shall be 1st September 2013. Property, rights and liabilities of specified companies vested in holding company

For the purposes of section 8(1) and this Order, the properties, rights and liabilities in respect of the companies specified in the Schedule shall become the properties, rights and liabilities of Darussalam Assets Sdn Bhd. 6 CAP. 264, O 2 (Incorporation)

SCHEDULE (paragraph 3)
Royal Brunei Technical Services Sdn Bhd
